confirmed: See the certificate your browser really received
Chain, TLS version, key exchange and Certificate Transparency, read straight from Chrome and confirmed by independent notaries.
intercepted: Notaries show what the rest of the internet sees. A different, unlogged certificate means something on your path is re-signing your traffic.
details: Names, validity, chain, fingerprints, key pin, OCSP and CRL, SCTs and extensions. Copy the PEM or download the chain.
